I liked the first two, but this third one is definitely the pinnacle .
Maya continues to display his strength as an artist with his provocative play.
Should you see it? Definitely. The play offers a valuable mirror of what is wrong with American society: the inability to listen and be open to new ideas.
The first act is strong and convincingly sets up the stakes for the second act... The second act feels a bit wobblier.
